title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl/wolfssl_ec_key.c/key_export_private
description: wolfssl_ec_key.c:303 wolfssl_ec_key_export_private() has no fips_gate() call. The ECDSA ops table wires this function directly as .key_export_private (wolfssl_ecdsa_p256_ops and wolfssl_ecdsa_p384_ops). The ECDH ops table goes through wolfssl_ecdh_key_export_private which does call the gate, but the shared function itself has none. Both ecdsa-p256 and ecdsa-p384 key_export_private invocations therefore bypass the gate. This is a CMVP compliance failure.
